system.description:
Unassuming humanoids with the uncanny ability to disguise themselves as inanimate objects, perhaps due to a curse or a mimic ancestor.

Mimicry

(KEY/Safe Rest) Action: Disguise yourself as a harmless inanimate object of the same size as you or smaller. You move at half Speed while disguised. Ends if you take damage, attack or cast a spell. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by DamianRM.
